messages:

Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + invoice submission question

Hi Rishi,

We're finishing the vendor onboarding for Zephyr Logistics and have two quick questions about invoice submission and template expectations before we go live with the first PO (PO: ZPH-9247).

1) Portal vs email: our ERP team has limited support for portal integrations this quarter. Is Redwood willing to accept invoices via email as a permanent channel, or should we plan to use a portal only as a temporary stopgap? If email is acceptable, please confirm any required subject token or header format.

2) Template/line items: our invoices are CSV-exported from our system and sometimes include multi-PO rows and VAT/withholding lines. Do you have a preferred minimal set of columns (PO#, line description, qty, unit price, tax, total) that will guarantee automated ingestion? Also: do you require vendor tax docs (W-9) at onboarding or at first invoice?

I've attached our completed vendor onboarding form and a sample invoice (sample_invoice_1234.pdf) for reference.

Appreciate a short checklist so we can map fields on our side.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Finance Operations Manager
Zephyr Logistics

Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice submission question

Hi Elena — welcome, and thanks for the form. Short answers up front then a checklist: we prefer portal submissions for reliability and automated PO matching, but we do support an email fallback for vendors that cannot integrate. Email fallback is considered permanent if the vendor is low-volume or constrained by ERP; for scale we encourage portal onboarding later.

Checklist / rules for email fallback ingestion (please share with your ERP team):
- Subject line must include the Redwood PO token: PO# ZPH-9247 or the subject "INV: ZPH-9247" to ensure automatic routing.
- PDF invoices preferred (single PDF with all line items). If CSV is required, ensure columns: po_number, line_number, description, qty, unit_price, tax, line_total.
- Multi-PO files: please split into separate PDFs per Redwood PO when possible. If not possible, put a top-level CSV column mapping each line to a PO.
- VAT/withholding: include a separate tax column and a final invoice total. Our AP system will surface tax lines but needs the explicit numeric field.
- Vendor tax docs (W-9 or equivalent): upload to our vendor portal or email to vendor-compliance@redwood.com during onboarding. We need the doc before first payment, so attach now if possible.

Attachments/reference: I uploaded our minimal invoice spec to the vendor onboarding Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBv-example-onboarding-guidance

I'll loop in Monica from AP and Logan from Vendor Ops to confirm the exception path and capture the onboarding token.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sourcing Manager
Redwood Inference

Elena — thanks for the example. A couple of operational notes from AP and Vendor Ops: 

1) Withholding/escrow: include the deduction as a separate line with a negative sign in line_total (or a tax_deduction column) and include a brief description "Withholding - escrow". That will allow ingestion without throwing a parse error.

2) W-9 naming convention: please send as "W9_ZephyrLogistics.pdf" to vendor-compliance@redwood.com. We will attach it to your vendor profile and confirm when complete.

3) Email fallback acceptance: we will enable a permanent fallback flag for Zephyr since you flagged ERP constraints. To trigger automated routing, make sure each invoice email subject contains exactly one of these tokens: "PO: ZPH-9247" or "INV: ZPH-9247". If the email contains multiple POs, list them in the subject separated by commas (e.g., "INV: ZPH-9247, ZPH-9248").

4) Internal follow-up: Logan, please create the SUP-809 exception to allow Zephyr to remain on email-only ingestion for up to 12 months and add monitoring so we can assess migration to portal.

Elena, I'll send a brief confirmation once the W-9 is posted and your vendor profile is live.

Regards,
Monica Patel
AP Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
